name: azure
description: Pipelines and approvals, pull requests, work items, and Azure resources through the az CLI, with confirmation before every change, plus live panes for runs, approvals, and pull requests

organization.title: Azure DevOps organization
organization.description: The organization the panes and tools read, as a name or a https://dev.azure.com/<org> URL. Empty: the az devops default.

projects.title: Projects to poll
projects.description: Comma-separated project names for approvals and your recent runs. Empty: the az devops default project.

adoTenant.title: Azure DevOps tenant
adoTenant.description: The Entra tenant ID the az token for Azure DevOps is requested in. Empty: the az CLI's current tenant.

tenants.title: Tenants for portal links
tenants.description: Comma-separated label=tenantId pairs, named in the system prompt so portal links open in the right directory.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the panes read Azure DevOps. Approvals refresh every second poll, your recent runs and pull requests every fourth.

humanOnlyApprovals.title: Approvals are human-only
humanOnlyApprovals.description: Refuse model tool calls that approve or reject a pipeline approval, so only the pane buttons decide one. Off by default so the pipelines skill can approve after you confirm.

linkHints.title: Portal link hints
linkHints.description: Give the model ready portal links for Azure resource IDs in tool results.

band.title: Buttons above the prompt
band.description: Show a Pipelines and a Pull requests button above the prompt, with the chord you bound to each.
